summary: Keep unchanged observer polls on their own timers instead of waking the reconciler.

replay.detail: No startup replay or projection invalidation changes.

schema.detail: No stored schema, migrations or wire formats change.

rules.detail: Observation normalization, delivery rules and RULES_VERSION are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Unchanged polls continue at their existing cadence without a global reconcile wake. Durable observations and error state changes still wake reconciliation; cancellation and retry deadlines remain fenced.

downtime.detail: The normal daemon restart activates the scheduling change; no coordinated restart is required.

manual.detail: No configuration conversion, repair or operator action is required.

recovery.detail: No stored format changes or additional recovery procedure; normal roll-forward guidance applies.
